summary: Frontend-only testing of Velora bilingual landing page. All 15 requested feature checks verified via Playwright on desktop (1920), tablet (768) and mobile (375). Age gate, hero phone mockup (full 5/8 aspect, no cropping, side phone overlaps right of main on desktop and hidden on mobile), page length (scrollHeight=10,877px), section order (all 14 sections present and in order), stats band (4 items), screens section (2 cards + nav strip), how it works (3 steps + download), creator hub (4 points + 85% stat), compare (9 rows), safety (6 items), FAQ accordion (default open, click toggles correctly, re-click closes), final CTA opens modal, navbar/footer links present, EN<->ES toggle switches all new sections (verified: 'Anuncios. Nunca.', 'DENTRO DE LA APP', 'PREGUNTAS FRECUENTES', 'Lista cuando tú lo estés.', 'GRATIS VS PREMIUM'), responsive at 375/768 with no horizontal overflow, zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: i18n.js is 528 lines — consider splitting EN/ES into separate files (en.js, es.js) for maintainability.
Hero.jsx hardcodes framer-motion transforms inline; could benefit from a motion variants constants file for reuse.
PhoneFrame uses external CDN image URLs (customer-assets-eiarnc6j.emergentagent.net) with no fallback/placeholder — if CDN is unreachable, the UI will show broken images with no graceful degradation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 15 features from the review request were verified passing. Hero mockup fix works: img uses object-contain with aspect 5/8 and renders at exact ratio (278x445 ≈ 0.625). Side phone overlaps the main phone's right edge on >=sm breakpoint (hidden on mobile). i18n toggles all sections correctly (stats/screens/how/creator/compare/safety/faq/cta). Zero console errors. APK download modal shows pending state as expected. No action items for main agent.
